publication.title: Knowledge Graph based Analysis and Exploration of Historical Theatre Photographs
publication.frozen_record_title: Knowledge graph based analysis and exploration of historical theatre photographs

source_reading.scope: Introduction; Recognition; KG Integration; Exploration and Exploratory Search

adjudication.basis: Primary position/method report proposes semantic facets and relation-based exploration grounded in a real RDF theatre-image collection; minimum workflow/guidance criterion does not require a completed user experiment. Proposed enhancements remain separate from existing temporal interface.

backend.source_model_description: Actual RDF Linked Stage Graph/SPARQL endpoint; GND/Wikidata/DBpedia links. Proposed Web Annotation/NIF2 object-detection provenance and confidence model.

descriptions.interaction: Existing timeline exploration of historical photographs over Linked Stage Graph; new semantic facet and relation-following extensions are proposed, not demonstrated.
descriptions.guidance: Proposed category/object facets, taxonomy aggregation and semantic recommendation; current guidance is not established.
descriptions.visualisation: Existing temporal image views; proposed relation-based interactive visualization is not implemented in this report.
descriptions.backend: Actual RDF Linked Stage Graph/SPARQL endpoint; GND/Wikidata/DBpedia links. Proposed Web Annotation/NIF2 object-detection provenance and confidence model.
descriptions.evaluation: Position/method proposal with historical-image examples; no recruited user study, accuracy benchmark or measured comparison.
descriptions.scalability: Collection nearly7000photos; date information only about2600 supports current temporal views. These are coverage/data counts, not latency measurements.

resources.notes: Current GET evidence only. HTTP success is not proof of repository code, valid license, reproducible installation or working demo; source identity review is required.
